name: Shadowmoor
description: Shadowmoor is the night-time mirror-image of Lorwyn, a plane of perpetual dusk and gloom where the races are transformed into darker versions of themselves.

description_citations.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Shadowmoor is the night-time mirror-image of Lorwyn, a plane of perpetual dusk and gloom where the races are transformed into darker versions of themselves.

citations.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Every three centuries Lorwyn's cycle transforms the plane into Shadowmoor, and the races there, without memory of their previous selves, are locked in a struggle for survival.

citations.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: The Great Aurora of Shadowmoor swept over Lorwyn and transformed Dwynen as she was about to shoot Nissa, who resisted a voice tempting her to stay and stepped through the void.

bio.text: Isilu, the living embodiment of Shadowmoor, walked past Goldmeadow and the darkness transformed the village into its Shadowmoor aspect.

status.text: As of the latest story, Shadowmoor is the night aspect of the plane, still intermingled with pockets of Lorwyn.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora of Shadowmoor sweeps over Lorwyn and transforms Dwynen as she is about to shoot Nissa.
timeline.quote: Dwynen was paralyzed, caught in the Great Aurora of Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa resists a voice tempting her to stay and, chanting Zendikar, steps through the void and follows a thread home.
timeline.quote: It pulled her with great force through the tear in the fabric of Lorwyn and out into the void.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys, a kithkin named Brigid, a merrow named Sygg, a flamekin named Ashling, and a treefolk sapling named Colfenor.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Pockets of Lorwyn sprout across Shadowmoor, splitting villages and throwing the plane into turmoil.
timeline.quote: Across Shadowmoor, pockets of Lorwyn sprouted up in the darkness.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor boggarts form the vanguard against the invaders, riding cavalry into enemy lines at great cost.
timeline.quote: The boggarts formed the vanguard, riding their cavalry into the enemy lines and gutting them from within.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor kithkin lead the last charge that destroys the Phyrexian invaders, then shut themselves in their homes.
timeline.quote: it was the isolationist Shadowmoor kithkin that led the last charge to destroy the invaders.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: The Hound of Bristlebane skewers a Dominus with a spear along a branch of the Invasion Tree.
timeline.quote: singlehandedly drove a spear through the body of a Dominus, skewering it from neck to knee

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor merrow escape to the Dark Meanders to wait out the invasion and adapt to their new environment.
timeline.quote: they escaped to the Dark Meanders, tunnels deep under the plane, hoping to wait out the invasion beneath the water.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Isilu walks past Goldmeadow and the darkness transforms the village into its Shadowmoor aspect.
timeline.quote: Everywhere the darkness touched, the city was transformed.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Erewaker crosses into Shadowmoor alone with the sapling, mocked by the faeries, and reaches the clearing with dawnglove.
timeline.quote: Dawnglove ahead. Her journey nearly to its end.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Erewaker performs the Rising ritual in the clearing while the faeries heckle her.
timeline.quote: Once she walks round the clearing. Twice.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: The ritual seems to fail, and the faeries urge Erewaker to cast aside her relic.
timeline.quote: Is cast aside your relic.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Erewaker lays down her relic and the sapling takes its first breath.
timeline.quote: The sapling takes their first breath.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: The faeries attack the relic and sapling, and an explosion of magic covers the clearing in dawnglove.
timeline.quote: Dawnglove grows like moss to cover all that it might.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Erewaker realizes the faeries herded the treefolk to this grove and dies as roots pierce her, her sap falling on the mound.
timeline.quote: but they'd been herded, like dogs, to this grove the whole while. To death.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Forget-Me-Not announces the Deffroad Clique's work is done as she dies fulfilling her purpose.
timeline.quote: What a delight it has been to be the Deffroad Clique,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys enters her late uncle Gethin's decayed house and finds the Reliquary of Twilight broken.
timeline.quote: The Reliquary of Twilight hadn't been used much in her uncle's final months

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys finds an unsent letter and a parcel of balsam salve addressed to Rhain Breckon.
timeline.quote: The tag was addressed to a "Mr. Rhain Breckon."

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys writes to Rhain to tell him of Gethin's death and sends the letter and parcel by enchanted paper wing toward the aurora.
timeline.quote: Not left, toward the city of Caer Flur, but right —toward the aurora.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys softens, picks nightphlox for Rhain and sends him a salve recipe; Rhain thanks her.
timeline.quote: Vanity was in Rhain's nature; helping was in hers.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys finds a hidden stem of dawnglove and an unsent letter that shows Gethin almost gave it to Rhain.
timeline.quote: This is what Rhain had asked Uncle Gethin for , she realized

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys asks Rhain if he is dying and he answers that he is.
timeline.quote: Not an hour passed before a reply settled on the desk in front of her.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Every three centuries Lorwyn's cycle transforms the plane into Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: every three centuries, that cycle transforms the plane into Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In Shadowmoor the plane's races, without memory of their previous selves, are transformed and locked in a struggle for survival.
timeline.quote: Here, the plane's races, without knowledge of their previous selves, are locked in a life-and-death struggle for survival.

citation.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The flamekin become smoking skeletons seeking revenge while the vain elves become humbled and heroic.
timeline.quote: the flamekin are now smoking skeletons seeking revenge.

citation.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
